parsed.reason: Leads with the useful registration fact, states only given facts (town, cycle, opening time, residents-first note, swim venue, kids, indoor, all ages, paid), and uses a permitted lead clause ('I checked', 'I found'). No hype, no invented specifics, no database-row feel. Slight dip for the two-paragraph split and the 'paid' phrasing being a little list-like, but overall plain and specific.
